senses.sense_definition: Any of the several species of plant in the genus Taraxacum, characterized by yellow flower heads and notched, broad-ended leaves.

examples.text: The bright yellow <w>dandelion</w> grew quickly in the middle of the green lawn.
Children often pick a <w>dandelion</w> to give to their parents as a small gift.

senses.sense_definition: The flower head or the white, fluffy seed head of the dandelion plant.

examples.text: She blew on the <w>dandelion</w> and watched the seeds float away in the wind.
The field was covered in a fluffy white <w>dandelion</w> after the flowers had finished blooming.

senses.sense_definition: A bright yellow colour, similar to that of the dandelion flower.

examples.text: The artist painted the sun using a vibrant shade of <w>dandelion</w>.
She wore a dress in a soft <w>dandelion</w> yellow for the spring party.

senses.sense_definition: Of a bright yellow colour, like that of the dandelion flower.

examples.text: The room was decorated with <w>dandelion</w> curtains that made it feel very bright.
He chose a <w>dandelion</w> paint for the kitchen walls to create a cheerful atmosphere.
